summary: USACE Old Hickory campground confirmed on rec.gov: 42 sites (stored 43), 50-amp + water, reservation-only, $35-40 (stored $30), weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night minimums, showers, laundry, dump. Lakefront KEPT (sites 31, 28, 12, 09, 33 within ~10-22 m of summer pool, 2.3-4.7 m above, open ground).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT: rec.gov tags 15 sites 'Lakefront' (08, 09, 11-16, 18, 20, 21, 26, 28, 31, 33, 34), ordinary nightly reservable sites at $40. 3DEP from the catalog points to Old Hickory's 445-ft summer pool (135.6 m): 31 at 36.302697,-86.513749 is 2.3 m above with the edge ~10 m east; 28 (36.303141,-86.513814) 2.4 m / ~18 m; 12 (36.304389,-86.513127) 3.4 m / ~18 m on a gentle slope; 33 (36.302492,-86.51393) 2.9 m / ~22 m; 09 4.7 m / ~19 m.
